I can provide a simple Java program to generate URLs.

Here's how you can do it:

```java
public class Main {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        String inputUrl = "https://example.com/path";
        System.out.println(generateUrl(inputUrl));
    }

    public static String generateUrl(String inputUrl) {
        return inputUrl;
    }
}
```

In this program, the `generateUrl` method simply returns the input URL as it is.

This will print:

```html
https://example.com/path
```

Please note that you need to have Jsoup library in your classpath to run this program. You can add it by including following dependency in your pom.xml file or build.gradle file (if using Gradle):

pom.xml:

```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.jsoup</groupId>
    <artifactId>jsoup</artifactId>
    <version>1.14.3</version>
</dependency>
```

build.gradle:

```groovy
implementation 'org.jsoup:jsoup:1.14.3'
```
